question: Where should the best teacher place Lakṣmī in relation to Gaurī?
premises: Gaurī is the reference deity for placement.
Lakṣmī is the deity to be installed.
The best teacher is the prescribed agent.
inference: The best teacher should place Lakṣmī on the right side of Gaurī.
plain_english: And the best teacher should place Lakṣmī on the right side of Gaurī.
